mapper.insert: insert into collect_connection (aim_id,account_id,type,is_collect) values( #{aimId} ,#{ownId},#{type},#{value}) on duplicate key update is_collect=#{value},update_time=now()
mapper.select: select aim_id from collect_connection where account_id=#{accountId} and is_collect=true and type=#{type} order by update_time desc limit #{start},#{need}
